blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) on Tuesday reminded overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) in Italy to prioritize their safety amid demonstrations in Milan. The advisory came after a demonstration on Sunday escalated into a confrontation between the Milan police and protesters which damaged some shops. “Manatiling mapagmatyag at umiwas sa mga lugar na may demonstrasyon o kaguluhan, kabilang ang matataong pampublikong liwasan,” the DMW said in a statement. (Remain vigilant and avoid areas where demonstrations or unrest occur, including crowded public squares.)
